description: Point an existing code at a new destination URL. This is the core of the product: the printed QR, its slug and its short_url stay byte-for-byte the same, only the redirect target changes, so a menu or price list can be replaced without reprinting anything. The change is live for the next scan, immediately, and the previous destination is kept in the audit trail (qrtap_code_history). Because it changes what real customers see, confirm the new URL with the user before calling.

codeId.description: The code id (UUID) as returned by qrtap_create_code or qrtap_list_codes.

name: qrtap_change_destination
